ingest.summary: Implemented all six ingest functions with validation, immutable cloning, deterministic subscription merging and newest-event routing. Added four boundary tests; original tests unchanged. Integrated own exports and handoff section. Role tests passed 10/10; final full suite passed 36/36 after peer exports completed. Used two indispensable await_next fallbacks for peer shared integration; initial full run had only missing peer exports. Observed diagnostic render cap 192 applies to view, not ingest.

delivery.summary: Implemented all six delivery functions, integrated exports and delivery handoff without replacing peer content, and added six boundary tests. Delivery tests passed 12/12; final integrated suite passed 36/36. Observed maxMessageChars=192 policy applies only to view, requiring no delivery changes. Used three await_next fallback calls after owned work and shared integration were complete to obtain peer export readiness; earlier calls returned queued coordination facts. Original tests and dataset unchanged.
